stem: Find the common domain of the function $n_2(x)=\frac{2x-3}{x^2-1}$. Tap the values that must be removed from R.

hints.text: Factorise the denominator as a difference of two squares; each factor gives a zero.
Only zeroes of the denominator are removed; the numerator does not matter.
For each factor set it equal to zero and solve; check the signs.
